        Transparent state engine

        What the Watch knows—and does not

        No calibrated score. Higher states require qualitatively different evidence.

        01

        Observations stay separate

        Quotes, filings, options, and delayed short interest retain provider, observation time, effective date, and limitations.

        02

        Derived is labeled

        Relative volume and shares-short as a percent of shares outstanding are deterministic calculations—not provider facts.

        03

        Inference has gates

        Reflexive requires observed feedback demand. Squeeze requires direct covering evidence plus stressed positioning and abnormal market activity.

        04

        Unknown lowers confidence

        Unavailable borrow data is not converted into zero, neutral, or normal. The system becomes less certain.

        State definitions and transition logic

        Dormant No material anomaly or positioning stress.

        Attention A market, catalyst, or attention anomaly without independent confirmation.

        Pressure Abnormal market activity plus multiple independent structural and demand confirmations.

        Reflexive Observed options concentration and observed feedback demand reinforce abnormal market activity.

        Squeeze Direct evidence of covering or forced buying alongside stressed positioning and abnormal activity.

        Dislocation A squeeze with exceptional liquidity or price-formation breakdown.

        Evidence monitor, not investment advice. A strong price move is not proof of short covering. Historical comparisons describe mechanisms, not forecasts.
